node.title: Clean-endpoint Forney resultant equals the regular factor
node.closure: exact Pade numerator and normalized resultant
node.statement: The reciprocal locator and first rho syndrome moments define a canonical polynomial P(t;X) of bidegree at most (rho-1,m+1). If a(t) is the leading X-coefficient of q and Delta(t) is the degree-(m-1) regular Kronecker determinant, then the fixed-degree resultant satisfies Res_X(q,P)=constant*a^(2rho+2)Delta. At each of at least 2m+3 good supported slopes, the same identity is Delta*a^3=constant*Vandermonde(S)^2 times the product of the nonzero Forney weights.
